heroSub: FiveStar AI ishushanya kandi yubaka ubwoko bwose bwa software - mobile, web, desktop, inyuma, na AI - ukoresheje LLMs kugirango ukore mu ndimi za porogaramu hamwe na tekinoroji.
m2Sub: Ururimi urwo arirwo rwose, urubuga cyangwa urwego
aboutLead: Turi sosiyete ikora software ya AI ifite uburambe bwimbitse mubikorwa byiterambere bya LLM. Duhindura ibibazo byubucuruzi mubicuruzwa byizewe tutagabanijwe nururimi rwihariye rwa porogaramu, urubuga, cyangwa tekinoroji.
missionBody: Dukoresha AI na LLM kugirango duhitemo ibikoresho byiza kuri buri kibazo kandi dutange murwego rwikoranabuhanga.
principlesBody: AI yihutisha akazi; injeniyeri zacu zikomeza kubazwa ibyubatswe, ubuziranenge, umutekano, nibisubizo.
focusBody: Igendanwa, urubuga, desktop, inyuma, abakozi ba AI, sisitemu yamakuru, hamwe no gukora byikora.
productsLead: Ibicuruzwa byacu byerekana uburyo dufata ibitekerezo byo gutangiza muri AI, mobile, inyandiko, itangazamakuru, na software itanga umusaruro.
p1: Imigendekere ya OCR ku mbuga zascanwe: gukura amakuru, gushaka, guhuza mu ncamake, TTS—iyitaho ku bwizerwa binyuze mu gukora ibyo amakuru aho byo.
p2: Byihuta, byoroheje byitangazamakuru ryibanze ridafite amatangazo nuburambe bworoshye kurubuga rwa mobile.
p4: Porogaramu ihuzwa na local AI kugira ngo ishoboce gukora ibintu mu buryo butandukanye no kuganira mu buryo bw'ibanga.
p5: Gutuma amafoto (screenshots) ya App Store byoroshye guhindura mu ndimi zitandukanye kugira ngo byoherezwe.
p6: Ikiganiro cy'ahantu hafi ishingiye ku bwemezabutumwe ukoresheje Bluetooth, hifashishijwe guhindura ururimi hakoreshejwe local AI niba ubishaka. Nta konti, nta saba ya central chat.
p7: Umuyobozi w'ibipapuro uzirondora aho uri. Yerekana coupon cyangwa ikarita y'ubunyamembership ikwiye mu gihe ugeze aho ugiye.
p3: Kuva muri sisitemu y'imbere na serivisi zurubuga kugeza mobile, desktop, nibicuruzwa bya AI. Duhitamo imvugo nziza na stack kuri buri kibazo.
b1: Porogaramu ya LLM & abakozi ba AI
b4: Akazi ko gukora no gutunganya amakuru
servicesLead: LLM yihuta yubuhanga ihindura ikibazo cyasobanuwe neza muri software ikora byihuse.
s1Body: Sobanura intego yubucuruzi, abakoresha, imbogamizi, nuburyo bwiza bwa tekiniki.
s2Body: Koresha LLM ifashwa nubuhanga mugushushanya, gushyira mubikorwa, kugerageza, no gusubiramo kurubuga.
s3Body: Kohereza, gukurikirana, gukora, no gukomeza kunoza ibicuruzwa.
contactLead: Tubwire icyo ushaka kubaka. Tuzatanga inzira ifatika kuva mubitekerezo kugera.
